sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents confirmed fraudulent activity investigated under case HHG-015. The primary subject of this investigation is customer C03042, holding card account C03042-K1. Between 2016-11-17 and 2016-11-17, the subject card account incurred unauthorized transactions totaling $599.94 USD. Investigation by the fraud unit confirmed unauthorized use consistent with card not present new device. Forensic device analysis revealed that online authorizations originated from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050'. Cross-graph analysis detected that this infrastructure is shared across multiple cardholder accounts, specifically: C02354-K2, C02923-K1, C04570-K1, C05876-K2, C07297-K1, C07671-K2, C07987-K2, C08299-K1, C08623-K2, C09933-K2, C11891-K1, C11923-K2, C12265-K2, C13171-K2. The coordination of activity across distinct cardholder identities indicates an organized card fraud ring. Customer and cardholder communications established that transactions were unrecognized and unauthorized by the legitimate account holder. Evidence synthesis: 3 graph and identity evidence claims collected. Total exposure in this fraudulent episode is confirmed at $599.94 USD. In accordance with bank fraud policy Section 3a: connected to shared device/ring across cards (R6) and regulatory filing guidelines, card C03042-K1 has been blocked and reissued, connected accounts placed under heightened monitoring, and this suspicious activity report filed.
